summary: The bounded ASML retry refreshed the security page and structured security row to the 2026-08-19 USD 1,751.73 mark and retained the complete primary-evidence scenario analysis. The required schema-v2 assessment command was rejected before changing assessment state because valuation_template_rationale was omitted even though the field must be present and empty for mature_compounder. The no-retry rule prohibited a corrected second assessment invocation. A post-failure security-context receipt confirmed that the canonical assessment remains the prior unsupported version. The existing controller issue was refreshed for this run; dependent relationship and idea operations were not enqueued, and no strategy, signal, order, allocation, execution, cash, portfolio, fill, performance, or other accounting state changed.
